scope: Review-only Master Charlie casting candidates; no stage scenes, no production assets, and not evidence
contractBoundary: This visual bible is authoring input only. It does not modify ContentBundle, Evidence, FSM, Finalization, Agent, Runtime, Domain, or Provenance contracts.

sharedDirection.identityIntent: A project-original, non-canonical adult Charlie with a distinctive and quietly magnetic presence. He must look like a believable person rather than a perfected model, stock-photo subject, actor, or literary illustration archetype.
sharedDirection.medium: A clean, photorealistic cinematic editorial portrait captured as a high-resolution RAW digital photograph; human casting photography, not an illustration or an imitation of printed artwork.
sharedDirection.framing: Vertical 3:4 chest-up or half-body portrait at natural eye level, single subject, relaxed shoulders, no theatrical pose.
sharedDirection.cameraLanguage: Believable full-frame digital portrait photography, approximately 85mm perspective, moderate shallow depth of field, natural optical bokeh, eyes naturally sharp without digital over-sharpening.
sharedDirection.lighting: Sophisticated soft directional window light with gentle negative fill, controlled highlight roll-off, dimensional but not dramatic, no fantasy glow or artificial rim halo.
sharedDirection.palette: Muted literary color palette: tobacco brown, faded navy, warm gray, soft cream, and restrained olive; natural skin color without orange-teal grading.
sharedDirection.skinAndFace: Visible pores, fine facial hair, faint under-eye texture, small tonal variation, subtle asymmetry, believable lips and teeth if visible, realistic moist eyes with non-identical catchlights, no beauty retouching.
sharedDirection.hair: Natural individual strands, slight flyaways, plausible density and hairline, no helmet-like clumps or glossy synthetic texture.
sharedDirection.wardrobe: Simple physically believable plain cotton collared shirt in a muted solid color, with normal woven fabric and natural folds; no costume styling, mottled print, logo, text, jewelry emphasis, or stage-specific uniform.
sharedDirection.backdrop: Quiet neutral real interior with smooth plaster and soft optical blur; no painted backdrop, canvas texture, bakery, laboratory, desk, book, paper, pen, clock, or stage narrative prop.
sharedDirection.expression: Restrained, attentive, emotionally available but not smiling for the camera; no melodrama, pity cue, diagnostic cue, or infantilization.
sharedDirection.finish: Clean high-resolution RAW digital editorial photography with natural microcontrast and highlight roll-off; physically plausible clothing folds and anatomy; no film grain, print grain, paper grain, canvas texture, painterly filter, aging overlay, or concept-art treatment.

prohibited: film adaptation likeness or film still
book cover or existing copyrighted illustration composition
readable text, pseudo-writing, logo, watermark, or signature
private source material, source quotation, or free-form user prose
over-sharpened facial detail or crunchy HDR
glass eyes, duplicated catchlights, or malformed pupils
fantasy glow, generic concept art, digital painting, or obvious AI illustration aesthetics
canvas, paper, paint, stipple, crosshatch, etched, distressed, or aged texture overlay
stock-photo smile or fashion-campaign glamour pose
exaggerated sadness, fear, genius pose, villain coding, or cognitive-disability caricature
deformed hands, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, or implausible clothing
reviewRubric: natural skin, eyes, hair, and anatomy
absence of generic AI illustration aesthetics
suitability as a stable identity reference

candidates.altText: Master Charlie 候选 A：一位三十多岁的男子在柔和窗光中以克制、开放的神情面对镜头。
candidates.faceDirection: Apparent age 34 to 37. A softly angular oval face, gently prominent ears, warm medium-brown eyes, one eyebrow subtly higher than the other, a long straight nose with a tiny natural deviation, a lean jaw, faint smile lines, short dark-brown wavy hair with an imperfect side part, and a quiet openness. Distinctive rather than conventionally perfect.

candidates.altText: Master Charlie 候选 B：一位接近四十岁的男子在安静室内呈现沉思而不疏离的气质。
candidates.faceDirection: Apparent age 37 to 40. A narrower oblong face, gently high cheekbones, hazel-brown deep-set eyes, uneven natural brows, a slightly crooked nose bridge, a modest chin, short chestnut-brown hair with a small cowlick and a receding-but-natural temple line, and a composed, thoughtful presence without coldness.

candidates.altText: Master Charlie 候选 C：一位三十岁出头的男子以安静、真诚而不过分微笑的神情站在中性背景前。
candidates.faceDirection: Apparent age 31 to 35. A balanced oval-to-heart-shaped face with a broader brow, soft but defined cheekbones, dark warm-brown eyes, a subtly asymmetric mouth, a straight medium nose, a fine jawline, short thick dark hair with loose natural texture and flyaways, and an earnest grounded warmth without youthful styling.

candidates.altText: Master Charlie 候选 D：一位约四十岁的男子在低饱和电影光线中呈现内敛而可信的存在感。
candidates.faceDirection: Apparent age 39 to 42. A rectangular-oval face with a slim build, deeper-set brown eyes, subtle temple and forehead lines, a broad straight nose with realistic asymmetry, gently prominent ears, a restrained mouth, short slightly unruly dark-brown hair beginning to thin naturally at the temples, and a reserved but humane presence.
